sources.label: Official Roman Size Guide (Roman Size Guide, cm; International Size Guide)

notes: UK brand popular for occasion wear and smart-casual staples. Its main size guide covers UK 10–22 (S = 10–12, M = 14–16, L = 18–20, XL = 22); Petite, Curve and Dusk ranges have their own charts. Runs true — one of the more reliable brands for second-hand buying due to stable sizing. Body measurements clearly listed on site.
audit: Site moved: romanoriginals.co.uk redirects to roman.co.uk; guide is /help/size-guide. Main 'Roman Size Guide' prints UK 10-22 (cm and inches; cm used), with US/EU from its International Size Guide. Old UK 10 87/69/93 -> 88.5/71.5/95; UK 14 96/78/102 -> 98.5/81.5/105; UK 22 119/101/125 -> 118.5/106/129.5. UK 8 and 24 removed (not in the main chart). Separate Petite (6-18), Curve (16-32, different numbers, e.g. 16 = 107.5/97/114) and Dusk charts not stored. Letter sizes span two UK sizes, so no altLabel. Notes corrected ('UK sizing 8–24' -> main chart 10–22).
